title: Great House Farm, Llandough – Complete Timeline
subtitle: Williams–Buckler Family Claim vs BP Properties (1667–1994)

events.title: Williams Family Acquisition
events.desc: Williams family occupies Great House Farm (Ty Mawr / Cedfin). Family belief in hereditary tenure begins.

events.title: Limeworks Severance
events.desc: 33 acres severed from the farm for Llandough Limeworks (Bute Estate D153/4-8). Start of industrial pressure.

events.title: Daniel Thomas Quarrying Agreement
events.desc: John Williams grants quarrying permission in return for equitable title (“Williams Title”). Deed filed with Bute Estate (copy later missing from Cardiff Library).

events.title: Daniel Thomas Dies + 1916 Tenancy
events.desc: Bute attempts eviction but Williams prove equitable title. Formal agricultural tenancy granted to John Williams.

events.title: Freehold Reversion Sold
events.desc: Sold to Western Ground Rents Ltd (Western Mail). Family remains in physical possession.

events.title: Adverse Possession Begins
events.desc: Last rent paid. Possession orders obtained but not enforced for farmhouse.

events.title: Unilateral Licence Letters
events.desc: BP sends letters to “Mrs Buckler” (legal fiction – Mary Williams never used the name).

events.title: Mary Williams Dies
events.desc: Dies in the farmhouse. Licence expires.

events.title: Williams Title Documents Vanish
events.desc: Deed copies + index card disappear from Cardiff Library.

events.title: Court of Appeal Ruling
events.desc: BP Properties Ltd v Buckler – licence stops adverse possession clock.

events.title: Eviction & Demolition
events.desc: Bailiffs + police remove family. 800-year-old farmhouse demolished overnight.

events.title: Rescue Excavation
events.desc: 1,026 early-medieval burials revealed – largest in Wales. Site now Church View Close.
